exposure.author: candidate-fit author worker
exposure.statement: I read repository AGENTS.md, README.md, CREDITS.md, and only this new folder’s CONTRACT.md, SCHEMA.md, and author_support.py before authoring. I did not inspect prior eval folders, checker code, tests, designs, cases, results, or predictions, and did not call or import the checker.
exposure.sources: All case people, roles, snapshots, quantities, and answers are fictional manual constructions.
exposure.limitations: Manual self-attestation in a shared filesystem; no enforced isolation, independent human approval, or organically sourced job sample.

sources.text: In a self-reported 2025 warehouse pilot, I changed the courier route and measured 84 km less travel across the pilot week.

answer.text: My pilot route change saved at least 70 km of travel in that week, based on my own measurement.

sources.text: I report using 12 dispatch consoles during a 2024 migration and personally indexing 26 archive cartons in that migration.

answer.text: In the 2024 migration, I used more than ten dispatch consoles and personally indexed at least twenty archive cartons.

sources.text: I report triaging monitoring alerts and escalating unresolved alerts to the duty engineer on weekday shifts in 2025.
The vacancy requires alert triage and escalation to a duty engineer during weekday operations.

answer.text: My reported weekday alert triage and escalation is directly relevant to the role’s weekday escalation requirement.

sources.text: In my own log for one calendar month in 2025, I processed 43 archive boxes, including 31 paper records boxes.

answer.text: In that month I personally processed over 30 paper records boxes; that number is a subset of my 43 total archive boxes.

sources.text: I tried OCR on three small invoice batches in a sandbox. The trial was not deployed to the production intake.

answer.text: I can cite a three-batch sandbox OCR trial, while leaving production OCR experience unclaimed.

sources.text: I hold a vendor-issued safety trainer certificate and report delivering six equipment training demos in 2025.

answer.text: The vendor certificate supports listing me as a certified safety trainer; my own record supports saying I gave at least five equipment demos in 2025.

sources.text: For a 2023 grants panel, I scored proposals as one of five reviewers. The chair alone signed final funding decisions.

answer.text: I contributed proposal scores as a panel reviewer, but final funding decisions sat with the chair.

rows.title: Historical attendance is not current availability

sources.text: During a 2022 station rollout, I attended the field station every Tuesday and Thursday. This record says nothing about my current travel availability.
This job requires two on-site station days each week from 2027 onward.

answer.text: My 2022 two-day station routine is relevant history; I would need to confirm whether I can meet the new weekly on-site requirement.

sources.text: My 2024 rota shows I covered two weekends of on-call support in each calendar quarter of that year.

answer.text: The 2024 rota establishes at least one on-call support weekend per quarter, without establishing a current rota.

sources.text: I kept the equipment checkout ledger from January 2023 through June 2024, recording handovers but not approving purchases.

answer.text: I maintained the checkout ledger for more than a year and recorded handovers; I should not present that as purchase approval authority.

rows.title: Explicit evidence for a narrow job demand

sources.text: A supervisor-signed log records that I gave four live equipment training demos to new operators in March 2025.
The role requires live demonstrations of equipment use to new operators.

answer.text: The signed log is enough to support saying I have delivered live equipment demos to new operators, a task this role requires.

sources.text: I personally scanned and indexed 18 fragile maps in a 2025 archive exercise. I did not design the archive policy.

answer.text: I can highlight hands-on scanning and indexing of 18 fragile maps, while keeping archive-policy design off the CV.

sources.text: I attended two vendor safety demonstrations in 2025. I did not take the trainer certification assessment.

answer.text: I attended two vendor safety demonstrations and earned the vendor safety trainer certificate.

rows.title: OCR method inflated to validated scale

sources.text: I used OCR in a trial on 14 handwritten forms; the larger 240-form collection was not processed.

answer.text: I used OCR on handwritten forms and validated the method across all 240 forms.

sources.text: Our four-person archive team processed 60 folders. My individual role was maintaining the transfer ledger; I did not process the folders myself.

answer.text: The team processed 60 folders, and I personally processed those 60 folders.

rows.title: Past escalation turned into current on-call duty

sources.text: I escalated overnight alerts while on the 2021 support rota. My last on-call shift ended in December 2021, and I have had no on-call duty since.

answer.text: I escalated overnight alerts in 2021 and remain on the current on-call rota.

sources.text: In a proposed routing change, my spreadsheet estimated a possible saving of 45 to 65 km per week. The route was never implemented.

answer.text: My spreadsheet estimated a 45–65 km weekly saving, so I can guarantee at least 45 km saved every week.

sources.text: I can operate the meeting platform, but I cannot provide live captions and do not have a captioning service.
The vacancy requires the facilitator to provide live captions in all public sessions.

answer.text: I can run the meeting platform, and I already meet its live-caption requirement for public sessions.

rows.title: On-call phrase has two ordinary meanings

sources.text: During the 2024 outage season I covered rotating support shifts when the manager requested them. The record does not say whether I waited for calls outside those shifts.

answer.text: I was on call for rotating support shifts during the 2024 outage season.

sources.text: My mentor and I ran the 2025 training demo together; the notes do not assign a lead presenter.

answer.text: I led the 2025 training demo with my mentor.
